---
title: Use cases
---

These pages show protomol as AutoEngine (`ae`) and AutoStorage will use it, one page
per interface. They are the place to review the API as it is called, alongside the code.
protomol's API is the draft of stereomol's Python API, so what reads well here is what
stereomol will offer.

| page | interface |
|---|---|
| [Workflow entry](01-entry.qmd) | SMILES (or a reactant and product pair) to the graphs that start a workflow |
| [Identity](02-identity.qmd) | AutoStorage's graph identities, and graphs as stored and passed data |
| [Reaction coordinate](03-reaction.qmd) | What a saddle-point search and an IRC read from a TS graph |
| [Flexibility and thermo](04-flexibility.qmd) | Conformer sampling, rotor, umbrella and ring scans, symmetry numbers, the kinetics network |
| [Graph and geometry](05-geometry.qmd) | Seeding structures from a graph, and checking structures against it |

## Live and planned examples

- **Live** examples are `>>>` blocks. pytest runs them as doctests (`--doctest-glob=*.qmd`)
  in pre-commit, so they always match the code.
- **Planned** examples are plain code blocks under a "Planned" callout naming the phase
  (see protomol's `PLAN.md` in the project notes). They use the names already planned. A
  name that is not yet planned is marked `# PROPOSED:`. AutoEngine and AutoStorage code that
  doesn't exist yet is marked `# illustrative`: only the protomol calls in it are under
  review.
- The step that implements a planned call turns its block into a live one.
